'''''Derbesia''''' is a [[genus]] of [[green algae]] in the family [[Derbesiaceae]].<ref name="Algaebase"/> The plant was originally known from different names applied to its larger [[sporophyte]], ''Derbesia'', and its less conspicuous [[gametophyte]], '''''Halicystis'''''.<ref>{{Cite book |author1=Hoek, C. van den |author2=Mann, D. G. |author3=Jahns, Hans Martin | title=Algae: An Introduction to Phycology | date=1995 | publisher=Cambridge University Press | location=Cambridge  | isbn=978-0-521-31687-3 | pages=429}}</ref>  ''Derbesia'' was successfully cultured in the laboratories of [[Germans|German]] [[phycology|phycologist]] [[Peter Kornmann]] to learn that both it and the plant ''Halicystis'' were different parts of the [[Biological life cycle|life cycle]] of the same organism.<ref>{{Cite book |author1=Langstroth, Lovell |author2=Newberry, Andrew Todd |author3=Langstroth, Libby |author4=Newberry, Todd |title=A Living Bay: The Underwater World of Monterey Bay |date=2000 |publisher=University of California Press/Monterey Bay Aquarium |location=Berkeley, Calif. |isbn=978-0-520-22149-9 |pages=[https://archive.org/details/livingbayunderwa0000lang/page/35 35] |url=https://archive.org/details/livingbayunderwa0000lang/page/35 }}</ref>

The genus name of ''Derbesia'' is in honour of Auguste Alphonse Derbès (1818–1894), French naturalist, zoologist and botanist,
Professor of Natural Sciences at the [[Aix-Marseille University|University of Aix-Marseille]].<ref>{{cite book | last=Burkhardt | first=Lotte | title=Eine Enzyklopädie zu eponymischen Pflanzennamen |trans-title=Encyclopedia of eponymic plant names | publisher=Botanic Garden and Botanical Museum, Freie Universität Berlin | year=2022 | isbn=978-3-946292-41-8 | url=https://doi.org/10.3372/epolist2022|format=pdf |language=German |location=Berlin | doi=10.3372/epolist2022 | s2cid=246307410 |access-date=January 27, 2022}}</ref>
